profile.name: PI E-709压电定位控制器
profile.description: 用于控制双通道或XY压电定位平台的运动控制器，可执行绝对/相对移动、伺服闭环控制、位置读取、到位判断和参考初始化，常用于显微成像中的纳米级定位与扫描。
profile.description_en: A motion controller for dual-channel or XY piezo positioning stages. It supports absolute/relative moves, closed-loop servo control, position readback, on-target checks, and reference initialization, commonly used for nanoscale positioning and scanning in microscopy.

A motion controller for dual-channel or XY piezo positioning stages. It supports absolute/relative moves, closed-loop servo control, position readback, on-target checks, and reference initialization, commonly used for nanoscale positioning and scanning in microscopy.
